Source: N: GNU Coreutils uniq 8.32 (Git for Windows), LC_ALL=C, Windows x64, 2026-11-09. No diagnostic after a downstream reader closed standard output early.
Acceptance criterion: If the reader closes standard output before all output is written, stop reading, write nothing to stderr and end within the case time limit.
Evidence limits: P01, P02 with input kept open and further lines arriving after the reader closes.
